title: Hygienist suggests watching a tooth, dentist decides to restore it

transcript.speaker: HYGIENIST
transcript.text: Number four has a little shadow on the distal, I'd just watch it.

transcript.speaker: DENTIST
transcript.text: Let me see the bitewing. No, that's through the enamel. Four needs a filling, distal occlusal.

transcript.speaker: HYGIENIST
transcript.text: Okay, I'll schedule a DO on four.

transcript.speaker: DENTIST
transcript.text: Cleaning and exam done today otherwise.
